text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"What heroic tale has 'Red' in its title
and features a girl saving the world from a dragon?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
Could it be 'Red Flame, Blue Dragon'?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Correct. What is the title of the blue-covered children's book
about a mermaid published 17 years ago?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You want to know about "Whispers of the Sea: Season 1", right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Correct!
That makes ten in a row... Magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Umm... it's an "experiment."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm currently researching memory mechanisms!
I'm observing the extent of synaptic changes
caused by positive-emotion-driven neurotransmission.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I remember it well because I like it.
...I am currently testing that hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... There's nobody using it right now, so I figured I'd lend a hand if I could.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...And with that, I've gathered most of the data!
Shall we proceed to phase two?! Let us see what happens when we introduce 'nervousness' to reinforced memories—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Rob Roy-kun.
A little bird told me an interesting story.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If all the bookshelves in the library were adjusted by a few centimeters,
the book capacity would increase by 1.3 times.
You're saying that's what you want?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but about that... It was rejected, they said
a complete overhaul would be too difficult...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What if I told you it could come true?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The reasons for rejection were likely budget and time.
If so, I have connections. I can make a request on your behalf.
...Assuming you answer my next question correctly, that is.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
P-Please...!
Let me do it...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! That's the spirit! Now then,
let's change locations! You need to feel "tense"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I will only ask once: "What is the title of the travelogue
published the year before last that features descriptions of fish dishes?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The description of the fish dish...
......

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Two possibilities come to mind.
But which one could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A travelogue about a clever cat unraveling the mysteries of the world.
'The Calico Cat's Wanderings'. Or—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "A travelogue of a former chef grandma journeying across the continent, sampling nourishing, energy-boosting dishes! 'Grandma Kiku: Devouring the Continent!'..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"If only I knew the mint year... Ah, but...!
...I-I'm so nervous, my memories are all jumbled up...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...T-Trainer-san...
Could you please decide for me...?!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please. I-If things stay like this,
I know I'll just keep agonizing over it forever...!
choice_data_list: Let's go with "Okiku's Devour the Continent!"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see, I see!
You narrowed it down to two options, but couldn't make the final call, is that it... Fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, well...
So, what's your answer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, that's a miss.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! N-No!
I'm the one who should apologize for asking...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
......
Um... Tachyon-san... If there's a next time...
could you let me try again...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm so frustrated by my own lack of knowledge...! Next time, I will have re-read every single book here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho... All of it?! Such cerebral stimulation is fascinating.
By all means, show me what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
Alright, first let's tackle that shelf over there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day on, she tore through books at an astonishing pace... witnessing firsthand the true passion of a literary girl.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So, what's the correct answer...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Correct! Well done!
...Leaving the final decision to him was also
a truly fascinating choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Correct! Well done!
...Leaving the final decision to her was also
a truly fascinating choice.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it!
We actually did it, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, the plan to completely reorganize the library bookshelves was quietly set in motion—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This, and this...
And this book looks nice too. ...Fufu. ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, that much? The shelf costs are... I'm probably gonna get nagged when I go back home. Oh well, whatever."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The library committee member could be seen
happily browsing for new books.
